title: Study of the Anatomical and Functional Recovery and Quality of Life of Patients Undergoing Corneal Transplantation
official: Prospective Observational Spontaneous Study of Anatomical, Functional and QoL Recovery of Patients Undergoing Corneal Transplantation
summary: Evaluate the well-being of patients and clinicl outcomes of the cornea after transplantation
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* be eighteen years old
* diagnosis of corneal disease with prescription of surgical treatment of corneal transplantation
* sign the informed consent

Exclusion Criteria:

* no exclusion criteria
